purpose: Fresh-seed four-PEMS H96 confirmation of the H12-qualified d24 full-coverage MambaTS v3 candidate.
research_question: Does the fixed d24 full-coverage candidate remain non-inferior on PEMS03/04/07/08 at H96 while retaining a low-latency prediction path?
selection_history: The full graph was fixed before these seeds by H12 validation and resource evidence: patch_len=24, patch_stride=24, d_model=24, d_ff=48, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1. H96 uses fresh seeds 2141/2142/2143 and changes only pred_len.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory long-horizon confirmation. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result permits a separately authorized same-source baseline matrix and test-release protocol; it is not itself a publication claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify four PEMS hashes and train-only normalization contract
freeze full-coverage p24/s24 d24 H96 candidate and exact lambda-zero graph
verify the pre-training PEMS07 d24 H96 GPU forward measurement

phases.name: pems_h96_fullcover_p24_s24_d24_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact d24 full-coverage H96 graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems_h96_fullcover_p24_s24_d24_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact d24 full-coverage H96 graph with lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: candidate versus historical H96 strong baseline references
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Use the fixed PEMS07 B32 L96 C883 H96 d24 resource preflight; full same-source resources follow only if accuracy passes.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No held-out-test or cross-horizon superiority claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
If active is more than 2% worse than the historical strong H96 reference on two or more dataset means, stop before same-source baselines or test release.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, do not claim causal AutoCon accuracy benefit.
Do not release test metrics from this confirmation.
